title: Cabinet — one Math Engine, carcass, worktop, doors and drawers
description:
A parametric CABINET on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE, A SEGMENT OR A SPACE. On a wall segment it takes the wall's direction with the doors facing into the room.

A BASE UNIT, NOT A BOX. Five carcass panels, a plinth set back from the door line, a drawer band at the top of the carcass, doors filling whatever height is left below it, internal shelves in the door bay only, and a worktop that overhangs on three sides.

THE DOOR HEIGHT IS DERIVED FROM THE DRAWER BAND, which is the ordering that makes this a cabinet rather than two independent stacks: `_bandH = n × drawerHeight` clamped to what the carcass can give, `_bandZ` is where it starts, and the doors run `_cz0 → _bandZ`. Change the drawer count and the doors resize themselves.

THE WORKTOP IS WHY THE BODY BOX IS NOT THE CARCASS. It is the only part that overhangs, so `_bodyL / _bodyW` — what the anchor and the fit are measured against — come from the worktop, not from the panels. Anchoring a run of cabinets against a wall then lines up the worktop edges, which is what is actually being aligned.

EVERY RUN IS ONE BROADCAST — door leaves, drawer fronts, shelves and both kinds of handle. Door handles ride the leading edge of their own leaf (`_db - 0.05`); drawer handles are centred on their own front. Neither knows the count.

THE PLAN IS DERIVED from the same quads with z dropped, the worktop drawn first so the carcass reads beneath it. Each part is its own 2D row because a grouped outline list is read EVEN-ODD.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 0.94 × 0.62 m over the worktop, 0.86 m high, two doors under a single 0.14 m drawer, 0.58 m² of worktop, 0.35 m³ internal.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Doors and drawer fronts are flat plates in the closed position — no swing, no open state, no hinge side. A corner or carousel unit is a different body.

params.name: Cabinet maths
params.expr:
_natL = width
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Wd = width * _s
_Dp = depth * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_t = panelThk * _s
_wtT = worktop > 0 ? worktopThk * _s : 0
_wtO = worktopOver * _s
_pl = plinthHeight * _s
_u0 = 0 - _Wd / 2
_u1 = _Wd / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Dp / 2
_v1 = _Dp / 2
_cz0 = _pl
_cz1 = _Ht - _wtT
_bodyL = _Wd + 2 * _wtO
_bodyW = _Dp + _wtO
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Carcass — five panels
_S1 = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u0 + _t, _v0, _u0 + _t, _v1, _u0, _v1, _cz0, _cz1, 1)
_S2 = hcat(_u1 - _t, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u1 - _t, _v1, _cz0, _cz1, 1)
_TP = hcat(_u0 + _t, _v0, _u1 - _t, _v0, _u1 - _t, _v1, _u0 + _t, _v1, _cz1 - _t, _cz1, 1)
_BT = hcat(_u0 + _t, _v0, _u1 - _t, _v0, _u1 - _t, _v1, _u0 + _t, _v1, _cz0, _cz0 + _t, 1)
_BK = hcat(_u0 + _t, _v1 - _t, _u1 - _t, _v1 - _t, _u1 - _t, _v1, _u0 + _t, _v1, _cz0 + _t, _cz1 - _t, 1)
# Worktop — the only part that overhangs, which is why the body box is measured from it
_WTr = hcat(_u0 - _wtO, _v0 - _wtO, _u1 + _wtO, _v0 - _wtO, _u1 + _wtO, _v1, _u0 - _wtO, _v1, _Ht - _wtT, _Ht, 6)
_WT = worktop > 0 ? _WTr : zeros(0, 11)
_PLr = hcat(_u0, _v0 + 0.03 * _s, _u1, _v0 + 0.03 * _s, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, 0, _pl, 3)
_PL0 = _pl > 0.001 ? _PLr : zeros(0, 11)
# Drawer band at the top of the carcass, doors filling whatever is left below it
_ndw = max(0, round(drawers))
_dwH = drawerHeight * _s
_bandH = min(_ndw * _dwH, max(0, _cz1 - _cz0 - 0.1 * _s))
_bandZ = _cz1 - _bandH
_fT = 0.018 * _s
_dwi = arange(_ndw)
_dwz = _bandZ + _dwi * (_bandH / max(1, _ndw))
_DW = hcat(fill(_ndw,1,_u0), fill(_ndw,1,_v0 - _fT), fill(_ndw,1,_u1), fill(_ndw,1,_v0 - _fT), fill(_ndw,1,_u1), fill(_ndw,1,_v0), fill(_ndw,1,_u0), fill(_ndw,1,_v0), _dwz + 0.004 * _s, _dwz + _bandH / max(1, _ndw) - 0.004 * _s, fill(_ndw,1,4))
_ndr = max(0, round(doors))
_dpitch = _Wd / max(1, _ndr)
_dgap = 0.004 * _s
_di = arange(_ndr)
_da = _u0 + _di * _dpitch + _dgap / 2
_db = _da + _dpitch - _dgap
_DR = hcat(_da, fill(_ndr,1,_v0 - _fT), _db, fill(_ndr,1,_v0 - _fT), _db, fill(_ndr,1,_v0), _da, fill(_ndr,1,_v0), fill(_ndr,1,_cz0 + 0.004 * _s), fill(_ndr,1,_bandZ - 0.004 * _s), fill(_ndr,1,2))
# Internal shelves, in the door bay only
_nsh = max(0, round(shelves))
_iz0 = _cz0 + _t
_iz1 = _bandZ
_shz = _iz0 + (arange(_nsh) + 1) * (_iz1 - _iz0) / (_nsh + 1)
_SH = hcat(fill(_nsh,1,_u0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_u1 - _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_u1 - _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v1 - _t), fill(_nsh,1,_u0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v1 - _t), _shz, _shz + _t, fill(_nsh,1,5))
# Handles — a bar on each door leaf and each drawer front
_hw = 0.018 * _s
_hdz = (_cz0 + _bandZ) / 2
_hdl = min(0.1 * _s, (_bandZ - _cz0) / 4)
_HD1 = hcat(_db - 0.05 * _s, fill(_ndr,1,_v0 - _fT - _hw), _db - 0.05 * _s + _hw, fill(_ndr,1,_v0 - _fT - _hw), _db - 0.05 * _s + _hw, fill(_ndr,1,_v0 - _fT), _db - 0.05 * _s, fill(_ndr,1,_v0 - _fT), fill(_ndr,1,_hdz - _hdl), fill(_ndr,1,_hdz + _hdl), fill(_ndr,1,7))
_hml = min(0.12 * _s, _Wd / 5)
_HD2 = hcat(fill(_ndw,1,0 - _hml), fill(_ndw,1,_v0 - _fT - _hw), fill(_ndw,1,_hml), fill(_ndw,1,_v0 - _fT - _hw), fill(_ndw,1,_hml), fill(_ndw,1,_v0 - _fT), fill(_ndw,1,0 - _hml), fill(_ndw,1,_v0 - _fT), _dwz + _bandH / max(1, _ndw) / 2 - _hw, _dwz + _bandH / max(1, _ndw) / 2 + _hw, fill(_ndw,1,7))
_HD = handles > 0 ? vcat(_HD1, _HD2) : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(_S1, _S2, _TP, _BT, _BK, _WT, _PL0, _DR, _DW, _SH, _HD)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Carcass3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Doors3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Plinth3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Drawers3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Shelves3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 5)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Worktop3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 6)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Handles3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 7)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
CarcassPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
DoorsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
DrawersPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
WorktopPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 6)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallWidth = _bodyL
overallDepth = _bodyW
overallHeight = _Ht
doorLeaves = _ndr
drawerCount = _ndw
worktopArea = worktop > 0 ? ((_Wd + 2 * _wtO) * (_Dp + _wtO)) : 0
shelfRun = _nsh * (_Wd - 2 * _t)
internalVolume = (_Wd - 2 * _t) * (_Dp - _t) * max(0, _cz1 - _cz0 - 2 * _t)
footprint = _Wd * _Dp
